# BubbleCraft - A Comprehensive and Optimized Minecraft Experience for Bubble Launcher

## Introduction: Redefining Your Gameplay Experience

**BubbleCraft** is a **comprehensive** modpack designed with a curated selection of carefully chosen and **well-optimized** mods. This package offers a wide range of Minecraft engagement, from advanced building and decoration to Create-based automation and essential performance utilities.

Our modpack is developed as a showcase project for our future official launcher, the Bubble Launcher. We prioritize long-term stability, low resource usage, and maintaining in-game balance. Our goal is to offer a consistent, stable, and **smoothly running** Minecraft universe where players can dive straight into the fun.

## Technical Details and Cross-Platform Performance

**BubbleCraft is a Client and Server Compatible Modpack.** Due to the inclusion of complex technical mods like Create, this modpack requires installation on both the client (your game) and the server to function correctly.

**For Minecraft 1.21.1 and Higher (Neoforge & Fabric):** In these newest versions, our optimization mod sets are largely similar across both the Neoforge and Fabric platforms. This helps in achieving high and stable FPS on the client. We maintain consistent performance through careful mod configuration.

**For Minecraft 1.21.0 and Lower Versions:** Due to differences in mod architectures, the optimization mod sets for these older versions differ significantly.
* Performance Note: General performance may be lower compared to modern versions due to inherent limitations in older game code.
* Content Note: Neoforge-based modpacks for older versions often offer a wider variety of content and features.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
<details>
<summary>Q: How can I install the modpack?</summary>
A: For now, you can use existing third-party launchers to download the modpack. However, in the future, we will recommend using the Bubble Launcher.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Q: When will the Bubble Launcher be available?</summary>
A: The development process for Bubble Launcher is ongoing. Currently, only the repository has been made public. Stay tuned for updates!

   - Launcher's GitLab link: https://gitlab.com/FluffyPal/bubble-launcher
    
</details>

<details>
<summary>Q: I can't find the keybinds for some features in the game. Why?</summary>
A: To prevent potential conflicts and unnecessary clutter, the seldom-used or default keybinds for some mods in our modpack have been disabled or changed. You will need to check the keybinds for the features you need in the in-game Settings > Controls menu and set them yourself if necessary.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Q: How much RAM does the modpack require?</summary>
A: We strongly recommend allocating a minimum of 6592 MB or more for packages.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Q: Which Mod Loaders and Environments does the modpack support? (Addressing Metadata & Linear Versions)</summary>
  
A: **BubbleCraft** is a **Client and Server Compatible Modpack**. Due to core dependencies, it requires installation on both sides. Separate releases for **Neoforge** and **Fabric** are provided in this single project. 
</details>
